description: Stable in React 19.3. Declares a subtree that animates with the browser View Transition API when a Transition changes it.
The four animation triggers. Each prop accepts a View Transition Class, `'auto'` or `'none'`, or a map by transition type.
Called inside `startTransition` to tag the Transition so different causes can animate differently.
Name React sets as `view-transition-class`, targeted in CSS with `::view-transition-new(.name)`.
Plain `setState` outside a Transition never animates.
